content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Deviation — GOVLAW (governing law and venue).** Section 28.1 imposed Singapore law with exclusive Singapore courts, outside the accepted list and in walk-away territory, and it contradicted Section 28.2's exclusive New York County venue. The validated redline substitutes New York law and the New York County state and federal courts in 28.1, reaching the preferred position with a single in-sentence change and resolving the internal conflict; Delaware, California, or England and Wales are offered as fallbacks in the comment.
